content: GitHub official event docs confirm pull_request GITHUB_SHA is merge commit; actions checkout supports explicit PR head SHA. Docker official docs recommend immutable digest pinning. Compare local and Actions actual git rev-parse HEAD and image digest before claiming same-commit verification. Sources https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/events-that-trigger-workflows and https://docs.docker.com/build/building/best-practices/.
